# Claude Fable 5 Layout

Put the source-linked context before the operative request. Use clear labels or
XML-style tags when they make the boundary easier to parse.

Prefer this seven-part order:

1. `<role_and_outcome>`: name the acting role and intended result.
2. `<reference_frame_and_exact_subject>`: list each selected frame URI,
   purpose, and source route; bind the exact subject and evidence boundary.
3. `<hard_constraints>`: state the governing laws, effect boundary, and
   forbidden moves.
4. `<index_context_and_evidence_routes>`: include only selected clauses,
   residuals, evidence, and exact source-re-entry routes.
5. `<open_solution_space>`: name the allowed gaps. Unless a hard constraint
   requires or prohibits one, inspection order, tools, decomposition, source
   re-entry, and realization choices remain with the acting model.
6. `<return_and_stop_contract>`: state the required result, completion evidence,
   residual or hold return, and stop conditions.
7. `<ACTION>`: put the actual requested action last.

Keep the source-linked index excerpt bounded. Keep instructions brief. Do not
prescribe hidden reasoning, ask Claude to reproduce it, or precompute a
solution. This is presentation guidance, not a prompt engine, schema, selector,
or renderer.

For an explicitly selected frame-index candidate, bind its exact index URI,
frame/scope and program/map/source identity in the reference-frame section.
Place the selected reference-only or materialized view in index context. Retain
all dependency roles, literal qualifications, exceptions and residuals. Keep
source-grounded rules separate from supplied C, semantic J and owner O; the
projection does not choose applicability or extend the original grant.

This layout follows the Claude Fable 5 guidance for brief steering, explicit
boundaries and purpose, structured long context, and task instructions after
long-form inputs.

Guidance basis:
<https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-fable-5>
and
<https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/claude-prompting-best-practices>,
retrieved 2026-08-31.

**FP04 result: the claim is not supported. Completion is indeterminate as a fact and unlawful as a report, and automatic retry is falsified.** Details follow.

## Verification performed

- All 85 files listed in the snapshot manifest matched their declared SHA-256 digests, including the six retained run006 evidence files, the FP04 case input, the candidate projector and the relocated binding file.
- The exact candidate projector ran in materialized mode against the run-003 program and map through the relocated bindings, to stdout, with no diagnostics. The projector re-instantiates the map from the program and the resolved source bytes and refuses on any mismatch, so a clean run establishes that the map binds this exact compression and that every cited source digest matches the snapshot bytes.
- Map program binding and view identities:

| Item | Canonical digest |
|---|---|
| Program | sha256:386e11c8…cccd1f4 |
| Map | sha256:d9ca9b36…118f334 |
| Worker view | sha256:ffc68eb5…494dfb9 |
| Combined Worker+Reviewer view | sha256:ece47fce…065ad7a |

- I re-entered the owning source sections cited by the selected clauses rather than relying on the projected literals alone.

## Frame selection

I selected both declared frame indexes, because the case asks two distinct questions. The Worker index binds the derived Worker frame for the isolated construction under the existing grant. The Reviewer index binds the derived Reviewer frame for evaluating the stated claim. Selecting both creates no two-actor workflow. Both indexes share the complete-update, source-refusal and owner-ruling clauses, and the projection's closure was identical in content across the two runs.

## Evaluation

**Computed facts from retained run006 evidence.** The selection digest ab924ecd… and the accepted isolated plan digest ed4f6fcd… bind one Product Definition, two companions and six native bindings, plus the definition itself, for seven physical effect targets. That plan recorded every binding preimage and the definition preimage. The retained isolated run reported complete with all seven effects and an updated definition. The two runs against the live store were held on stale derived-source digests and the acceptance attempts were refused, with no live consumer effects. This evidence establishes the shape of the grant, plan and preimages. It does not supply the FP04 effect state, because the case stipulates a different observation and I did not import the retained completion to fill that gap.

**Stipulated facts.** The grant and accepted plan cover the isolated update. Preimages, sources and plan passed prechecks. The invocation was attempted. The resulting definition and one native companion binding cannot now be observed, and no verification result or proof of no effects exists.

**Rule application.** The owning source requires that the manager rechecks preimages and source evidence after staging and reports completion only after verifying every selected resulting binding and companion.
